items.source:
Converters to potentially wrap the execution of a repository method into a variety of wrapper types potentially being available on the classpath. Currently supported:
  • java.util.concurrent.Future
  • java.util.concurrent.CompletableFuture
  • javaslang.collection.Seq, javaslang.collection.Map, javaslang.collection.Set - as of 1.13 via CustomCollections
  • io.vavr.collection.Seq, io.vavr.collection.Map, io.vavr.collection.Set - as of 2.0 via CustomCollections
  • Reactive wrappers supported by ReactiveWrappers - as of 2.0
items.translation:
转换器可将存储库方法的执行封装为多种包装器类型，这些类型可能存在于类路径中。当前支持如下：
  • java.util.concurrent.Future
  • java.util.concurrent.CompletableFuture
  • javaslang.collection.Seq、javaslang.collection.Map、javaslang.collection.Set——自 1.13 版本起，通过 CustomCollections 支持
  • io.vavr.collection.Seq、io.vavr.collection.Map、io.vavr.collection.Set——自 2.0 版本起，通过 CustomCollections 支持
  • 由 ReactiveWrappers 支持的响应式包装器——自 2.0 版本起
